### Mod Version

netherportalfix-forge-1.18-9.0.0

### Balm Version

balm-3.2.6.jar

### Describe the Issue

I installed a Minecraft server with Forge & nothing else. Boots fine.

I only added the 1 mod & its dependency file nothing else on a fresh server install to try it out & it fails to boot.

The docs on curseforge state balm-3.2.6.jar is supposed to support 1.18.1 but it doesn't appear to.

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
I've corrected the supported versions on CurseForge and Modrinth.

1.18.1 is an oddly specific version to choose - you should at least try to get to 1.18.2 (which was mostly compatible with 1.18.1) to avoid these kind of problems. Older versions will always be missing fixes and features and most modders chose 1.18.2 as an LTS version in the past.
